turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Pinecrest Luggage customer support, this is Oscar. What can I do for you today?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Hi. I bought one of your carry-on suitcases last spring, and one of the wheels just snapped off during a trip. Is that covered by the warranty?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: It should be. Our wheels are guaranteed for five years. Could I have the name on the order?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Sure. It's Fiona Marsh. I have the receipt right here, too.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Thanks, Ms. Marsh. I can see the purchase. Instead of having you ship the whole suitcase back, we can mail you a replacement wheel kit. You only need a screwdriver to install it.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Oh, that's easier than I expected. How long will it take to arrive?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: About three business days. I'll also e-mail you a short video that shows how to attach it.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Perfect. I'll keep an eye on my inbox, then.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Hugo, I was reconciling last month's payments, and it looks like we paid Corvane Packaging's March invoice twice.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Twice? How did that happen?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The invoice came in by mail and by e-mail, and each copy was entered as a separate bill. The total was just over $6,000.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That's not a small amount. Have you contacted Corvane yet?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I called their billing office this morning. They confirmed the extra payment, and they offered to either refund it or apply it as a credit to our next order.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Well, we order from them every month.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That's what I was thinking. A credit would save everyone some paperwork.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Agreed. And let's make sure this doesn't happen again. Could you set up our accounting system so it flags any invoice number that's already been entered?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Sure. I'll ask the software company how to turn that feature on this afternoon.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Chef Tariq, the dishwasher in the back just stopped in the middle of a cycle. There's water sitting in the bottom.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Not now. We open for lunch in less than an hour. Did you try restarting it?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Twice. The power light comes on, but nothing happens. I called the repair company, and the earliest they can come is three o'clock.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Okay. Until then, we'll have to wash everything by hand. Can you ask Leo to come in early to help?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Sure. He lives nearby, so he can probably be here in twenty minutes.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Good. And let's use the paper cups for coffee today. That'll cut down on the dishes.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I'll get them from the storage room right away.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Mr. Lindqvist, thanks for coming in. I've put together a list of the retail spaces that are available downtown right now.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Great. As I mentioned on the phone, I'm opening a second location for my bakery, so I'll need room for two large ovens.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Right. How much space do you think that requires?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: My contractor said at least eighty square meters. And my budget is firm. I can't go over $3,500 a month in rent.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then there's really only one option on this list that works for you. It's also close to a bus stop, so you'd get plenty of morning commuters.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That sounds promising. When could I see it?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The current tenant moves out on Friday. I could take you there Saturday morning.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Saturday works. I'll bring my business partner along so she can see it too.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Felix, I just got the numbers from last week's e-mail campaign for the Lumora skincare line. Only eight percent of customers opened it.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That's about half of what we usually get. Do you think the subject line was the problem?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Maybe. It was pretty long, and on phones most of it got cut off.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Then let's try something different next time. We could send two versions with different subject lines to a small group first and see which one does better.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Good idea. I'll write a few short options today.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Great. And send them to Rosa in design before Thursday. She wants to check that the subject lines match the images in the e-mail.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Will do. I'll copy you on the message, too.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription under the name Ivan Petrov. My doctor said she'd send it over yesterday afternoon.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Let me check, Mr. Petrov. Yes, we received it, but it's on hold. Your insurance plan needs your doctor to confirm that you've tried a lower-cost medication first.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Oh, I actually took the cheaper one for about two months last year. It didn't help much.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then it should be approved without any trouble. It's just that the form has to come from your doctor's office, not from us.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I see. I'm leaving for a conference on Monday, though, and I'd really like to start the new medicine before then.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: In that case, I'd recommend calling her office yourself this afternoon. Patient requests tend to get handled faster. Meanwhile, I can give you a three-day supply at no charge so you won't have to wait.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That would be a big help. Thanks.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Hi, I reserved a compact car for three days. The name's Jonas Weber.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Welcome, Mr. Weber. Hmm, it looks like all our compact cars are still out. Several customers returned theirs late this morning.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That's a problem. I have a client meeting downtown at two.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Let me check with my manager. Grace, do we have anything else available for Mr. Weber?

turns.speaker: W2
turns.text: We've got a midsize sedan that was just cleaned. Mr. Weber, we can give you that for the compact price.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Really? That's very generous.

turns.speaker: W2
turns.text: It's the least we can do. It does use a bit more fuel, but you'll have more room for luggage.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I'll take it. I've only got one small bag, though.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: All right. I'll just need to see your driver's license, and you'll be on your way.

turns.text: Twelve. And the three of us will be there, plus the trainer from headquarters.

turns.speaker: M2
turns.text: So sixteen. Cedar would hold exactly that many, wouldn't it?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: It would, but it'd be a tight squeeze with laptops on the tables. Let's not book a room that's completely full.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Agreed. I'll take the next size up. Victor, can you make sure the new hires' ID badges are ready by Wednesday?

turns.speaker: M2
turns.text: Sure. I still need photos for two of them, though. I'll e-mail those two this afternoon and ask them to send some.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: And I'll print the training handbooks tomorrow morning.

translationTH: แพทริก วิกเตอร์ ขอบคุณที่แวะมานะ ฉันกำลังจองห้องสำหรับการปฐมนิเทศวันพฤหัสบดี และอยากให้แน่ใจว่าจำนวนคนถูกต้อง
พนักงานใหม่เริ่มงานกี่คน
สิบสองคน แล้วเราสามคนก็จะอยู่ด้วย บวกกับผู้ฝึกอบรมจากสำนักงานใหญ่
รวมเป็นสิบหกคน ห้อง Cedar จุได้พอดีเลยไม่ใช่เหรอ
ได้พอดี แต่จะเบียดกันมากถ้ามีแล็ปท็อปวางบนโต๊ะ อย่าจองห้องที่เต็มพอดีเลย
เห็นด้วย ฉันจะจองห้องที่ใหญ่ขึ้นไปอีกขนาดหนึ่ง วิกเตอร์ ช่วยดูให้บัตรประจำตัวของพนักงานใหม่เสร็จภายในวันพุธได้ไหม
ได้ แต่ผมยังขาดรูปของสองคนอยู่ บ่ายนี้ผมจะอีเมลหาสองคนนั้นและขอให้ส่งรูปมา
ส่วนผมจะพิมพ์คู่มือการฝึกอบรมพรุ่งนี้เช้า
tipTH: ข้อ graphic แบบยาก มักต้องคำนวณตัวเลขจากบทสนทนา แล้วฟังคำบอกทิศทาง เช่น the next size up เพื่อเลื่อนไปยังแถวถัดไปในตาราง
